outcome: Triple burden of malnutrition (overweight/obese mother with undernourished and anemic under 5 years child)
cohort: 116,795 mother-child pairs from 22 low-income and middle-income countries
finding: The pooled prevalence of the triple burden of malnutrition among mother-child pairs was 11.39%, with significant associations found for various maternal, child, household, and community-level factors.
mod_finding: Delivery by cesarean section was positively associated with the triple burden of malnutrition.
